scientific_integrity: Analytic proof and reproducible exact-arithmetic checks; generic matrix error expansion and exact three-by-three witness with separately described limits.
scientific_limitations: The first-order obstruction is for three bounded flows with a fixed descending Fisher–Yates implementation, unscreened serial binary radical-inverse entries, and exact arithmetic. The source uses an abstract Fisher–Yates map, so its experimental implementation need not match this variant. Independent validation has not been performed.
title: First-order digit aliasing in three-flow van der Corput splitting
